messages:
zoe: FYI deploy-bot just tripped a post-canary tail latency alert for release v3.7.1 (~620ms p95). We have Dedicated traffic on the route. Do we let auto-run or suppress?

deploy-bot: Policy hit: p95 > 500ms for 3m on canary slice. Recommended action: autorevert to v3.6.9. Note: autorevert impacts all slices unless pinned.

peter: If auto runs, Dedicated customers could get unexpected changes. Propose a safety-latch: suppress auto and do a canary-only rollback + pin critical routes.

mohit: Agreed. Quick log peek shows repeated kvcache misses and a quant fallback path. Kernel fallback looks new in this candidate.

ops-bot: @zoe hold placed: auto-rollback suppressed for 10 minutes. Operator hold id: hold-4867-1.

zoe: Plan: 1) rollback canary to 3.6.9; 2) pin dedicated-eu and dedicated-us to 3.6.9; 3) send a short CS blurb; 4) open post-mortem to triage kernel selector. Who runs rollbacks?

peter: I'll run them. Commands: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=inference --to-version=3.6.9 --slice=canary --reason="post-canary p95"` and `redwoodctl routes pin --route=dedicated-eu --version=3.6.9`

ops-bot: ACTION: peter started rollback at 2026-09-02T15:09:12Z. job=rb-4867001234-a

peter: Canary rollback complete. Running quick smoke.

peter: Smoke: p95 down to 115ms, 502s removed from canary logs. Dashboards look normal.

trusted-cs: Drafting short CS note: "During a canary rollout we observed increased tail latency impacting a small subset of traffic. We reverted the canary and pinned Dedicated routes as a precaution. No action required from customers; we will follow up with a detailed post-mortem."

zoe: Opening PM ticket PM-7890 with logs and rollback commands. We'll hold the pins for 1h then hand back to deploy-bot. Recommendation: block the new kernel flag until CI validates it.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback & pins recorded. Suggest adding a kernel-selection regression test to preflight checks.

zoe: Closing thread for now. Ping here if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
